What the paper reports
scope-02
result
Result
Perceived risk was negatively associated with evaluation (b=−0.50, p<.001 in Model 3). Illusion of control predicted lower perceived risk (b=−0.76, p<.01); its evaluation coefficient fell when perceived risk was added. The authors report weaker evidence for a direct small-samples association (b=1.17, p<.06 in Model 2).
